name: Brewmaster Drohn
summary: Above Ratchet's docks, Brewmaster Drohn tends his brewing craft. The orc lives just uphill from the port, making potent drinks with methods tied to the wandering pandaren Chen Stormstout. Travelers who find discarded kegs across Kalimdor are sent to Drohn's porch.

sections.title: A Master of the Craft in Ratchet
sections.body: Brewmaster Drohn brews from his home on the hill above Ratchet's goblin docks. Rather than devote himself to combat, the orc has given his craft to brewing. He lives peacefully in the neutral haven established by Gazlowe's Steamwheedle cartel. While many orcs favor coarse grog or simple spirits, Drohn works with rare ingredients, carefully balanced flavors, and methods seldom practiced among his kin.

sections.title: The Pandaren Connection
sections.body: Brewmaster Drohn learned brewing through a mentor who studied under Chen Stormstout, the pandaren wanderer who fought beside Rexxar and the Horde during the founding of Durotar. Chen also taught Drohn to make Trogg Ale. When travelers find Chen's discarded kegs in the wilds, Drohn is the only local authority who can identify their ingredients and recreate the wanderer's potent brews.

faq.answer: Brewmaster Drohn brews in Ratchet, in the Barrens. The orc is known for exotic ales and ties to the brewing traditions of the wandering pandaren Chen Stormstout.

faq.q: How does Drohn know Chen Stormstout?
faq.answer: Drohn learned from a mentor who was taught to brew Stormstout by Chen Stormstout. Chen later taught Drohn how to make Trogg Ale.

faq.q: What should I do if I find Chen's Empty Keg?
faq.answer: Take Chen's Empty Keg to Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet. He recognizes Chen's handiwork and sends you to find the rare local ingredients needed to recreate the brew.

faq.q: Is Brewmaster Drohn aligned with the Horde?
faq.answer: Yes. Drohn is an orc of the Horde, though he lives and brews in Ratchet, a neutral goblin port. Attacking him harms an Alliance adventurer's standing with Ratchet and the Steamwheedle Cartel.

faq.q: What kind of drinks does Drohn make?
faq.answer: Drohn makes potent brews, including Trogg Ale and Chen Stormstout's namesake Stormstout. They call for tusks, glands, and other parts from beasts found across the Barrens.
Find Drohn outside his house on the hill overlooking Ratchet, just northwest of the main docks in the Barrens.

angles.text: If you practice cooking, Drohn's skill lies in blending rare flora and fauna into fine drinks in the desert.
As an orc, you may see Drohn's brewing as one way to turn the peace of Durotar and the Barrens into a craft, unlike the fortresses many warriors built after following Thrall to Kalimdor.
As an Alliance adventurer, know that Steamwheedle protects Drohn in Ratchet. Attack him, and the local goblin authorities will turn against you.
